\section*{Course Overview \& Syllabus Blueprint}
Differential Equations, Linear Algebra, Multiple Integrals, Vector Calculus and 3D Geometry with past paper solutions and formula sheets.

\vspace{0.5cm}

\section*{Key Examination Tips for IOE Students}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Always state standard assumptions and definitions before starting derivations.
  \item Draw neat, labeled schematic diagrams wherever applicable.
  \item Show every algebraic and calculus step explicitly to maximize step marks.
  \item Box final numerical results with accurate SI units.
\end{itemize}
